service.name: dev.avyos.dbg
service.description: Remote debugging and control API over Sutra/TCP for authenticated command execution, shell calls, and file transfer.

types.name: AuthRequest
types.description: Authentication request for a target identity.

types.name: SessionInfo
types.description: Authenticated session descriptor returned after login.

types.name: SessionToken
types.description: Session token used to authorize subsequent requests.

types.name: ReadFileRequest
types.description: Read a file chunk from remote host.

types.name: WriteFileRequest
types.description: Write a file chunk to remote host.

requests.name: Authenticate
requests.description: Authenticate and create a debug session.
requests.response_description: Returns session token and identity context.

requests.name: RunCommand
requests.description: Execute a command as the authenticated identity.
requests.response_description: Returns exit code and captured output streams.

requests.name: RunShell
requests.description: Execute command line through shell semantics as authenticated identity.
requests.request_description: Provide token and shell command line.
requests.response_description: Returns exit code and captured output streams.

requests.name: ReadFile
requests.description: Read a binary file chunk from remote host.
requests.request_description: Provide token, path, offset and chunk size.
requests.response_description: Returns data chunk and EOF marker.

requests.name: WriteFile
requests.description: Write a binary file chunk to remote host.
requests.request_description: Provide token, path, offset and data bytes.
